package: @astryxdesign/core

# CommandPaletteFooter

CommandPalette renders CommandPaletteFooter automatically. Pass a CommandPaletteFooter to the footer slot only when replacing the default guidance.

Anatomy: Footer, Keyboard shortcut (optional)

## Import

```tsx
import { CommandPaletteFooter } from '@astryxdesign/core/CommandPalette';
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `children` | `ReactNode` | - | Custom footer content. When omitted, renders default keyboard hints via Kbd. |
| `xstyle` | `StyleXStyles` | - | StyleX styles for layout customization. Must be a stylex.create() value. |
